𑁍 ָ࣪ ˖**Explosion;**𖥔 ۫ ּ

> 💭 ᝢ__Explosion allows the user to excrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignite it at will to create explosions of various sizes.
Through either one of his palms, Katsuki creates fiery shock waves that are highly powerful and destructive, often burning and/or shattering whatever they hit, with Katsuki himself being immune to them, save for some minor damage from the recoil. Because this Quirk generates light, it's a natural counter to Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow, which thrives in the dark.
The more Katsuki sweats, the more powerful the explosions become. This essentially means that Katsuki's blast gradually grows in power the longer he fights, since he will naturally sweat more through ongoing physical activity.__

> **꒰👤꒱ Usuário ➳** __Katsuki Bakugo__

 ⭐ Tipo de quirk ：__`Emissora`__
